title: 第2651章 极道之魂第2650章 唐某等候多时了
lines: “唐某，等候多时了。”
伴随着这道轻笑声。
整个天冥地窟猛然震荡，而后，虚空中荡出波纹涟漪，一名黑衣青年漫步走出。
“唐青冥？”
苍隗瞳孔一缩。
就连天冥老祖也无比惊愕：“唐道友？”
唰！
苍隗瞬间朝天冥老祖与唐明二人扫视一眼，不知为何，在看到天冥老祖那惊愕的表情后，他心中升腾起一股不妙的感觉。
紧接着。
在唐明身后，又一道虚空波纹荡漾开来。
上古镇守使，轩辕灏，手持猎神枪缓缓浮现，那股狂烈战意，瞬间充斥整个地窟空间。
“苍隗，等你多时，今日终于露面了。”
唐明看向前方，目光直接锁定其中一道分身，这道分身内部，就蕴藏着苍隗的本命神魂。
“找死！”
苍隗目光瞬间锐利。
神念一动。
一柄金灿灿的飞剑凭空凝聚，而后，在邪魔图腾加持下，金色飞剑转瞬化作乌黑，一道道诡异的邪魔之力勾勒其中，释放出雄浑的死寂之气。
二话不说。
苍隗直接操控两道分身杀向唐明。
轩辕灏挥舞猎神枪，朝另外两道分身掠去。
虚空破碎。
死寂黑刃在邪魔之力的加持下，气息极为恐怖，一刀斩下，地窟空间猛然被撕裂。
唐明眸光淡漠，丝毫不为所动，他深邃的瞳孔中有神光弥漫，而后反手下压。
“轰隆！”
掌印如巍峨神峰般镇杀而至。
就在双方碰撞的瞬间。
苍隗其中一道分身蓦然自爆，恐怖的威能朝四周扩散，令地窟空间寸寸迸裂，而后，一缕神意蓦然涌入破碎虚空中。
唐青冥的突然出现，完全打乱了苍隗的计划。
他本来是打算暗中炼化天冥老祖，然后悄然吞噬两大本源。
但如今。
唐青冥与轩辕灏的突然出现，彻底让苍隗的计划没法执行，毕竟，他是亲眼见过唐明的圣巫秘法，能完全压制住邪魔之力。
有唐青冥在。
自己绝对没可能吞噬两大本源。
既然计划失败，那么继续留在这便没有意义，而且……自己布局多时的计划被人族识破，让苍隗心中升起了危险的感觉。
必须先走！
content_en:
"Tang, I've been waiting for a long time."
Accompanied by this chuckle.
The entire Tianming Cave shook suddenly, and then, ripples appeared in the void, and a young man in black walked out.
"Tang Qingming?"
Cang Wei's pupils shrank.
Even Patriarch Tian Ming was extremely shocked: "Fellow Taoist Tang?"
Uh-huh!
Cang Wei instantly glanced at Patriarch Tianming and Tang Ming. For some reason, after seeing the shocked expression of Patriarch Tianming, he felt an unpleasant feeling in his heart.
Immediately afterwards.
Behind Tang Ming, another ripple in the void rippled.
The ancient town guardian, Xuanyuan Hao, slowly emerged with a hunting gun in his hand, and his fierce fighting spirit instantly filled the entire cave space.
"Cang Wei, I've been waiting for you for a long time, but you finally showed up today."
Tang Ming looked forward, his eyes directly locked on one of the clones. Inside this clone, Cang Wei's natal soul was contained.
"Seeking death!"
Cang Wei's eyes suddenly became sharp.
A thought flashed through his mind.
"Zheng!"
A golden flying sword condensed out of thin air, and then, with the blessing of the evil totem, the golden flying sword instantly turned into black, and strange evil power was outlined in it, releasing a powerful aura of death.
"Kill!"
Say nothing.
Cang Wei directly controlled the two clones to kill Tang Ming.
Xuanyuan Hao waved his hunting spear and flew towards the other two clones.
"Bang!"
The void shattered.
The black blade of death, blessed by the power of evil spirits, had an extremely terrifying aura. With one slash, the cave space was suddenly torn apart.
Tang Ming's eyes were indifferent, unmoved at all. His deep pupils were filled with divine light, and then he pressed down with his backhand.
"Boom!"
The palm prints are like towering divine peaks that suppress and kill.
At the moment when the two sides collided.
One of Cang Wei's clones suddenly self-destructed, and the terrifying power spread in all directions, causing the cave space to burst open, and then, a ray of divine will suddenly poured into the broken void.
Tang Qingming's sudden appearance completely disrupted Cang Wei's plan.
He originally planned to secretly refine the Tian Ming Patriarch, and then quietly devour the two origins.
But now.
The sudden appearance of Tang Qingming and Xuanyuan Hao completely made it impossible for Cang Wei to execute his plan. After all, he had seen with his own eyes that Tang Ming's holy witch secret method could completely suppress the power of evil spirits.
Tang Qingming is here.
It is absolutely impossible for him to swallow the two origins.
Since the plan failed, there is no point in staying here, and...the plan he had laid out for a long time was discovered by the human race, which made Cang Wei feel dangerous in his heart.
Must go first!
title_en: Chapter 2651 The Soul of the Ultimate Chapter 2650 Tang has been waiting for a long time
